All chords have the same shorter circular length. An earlier chord crosses the new chord exactly when one endpoint is strictly inside its short arc; no equal-length chord has both endpoints strictly inside. Fenwick counts endpoints with multiplicity and excludes shared endpoints. Each crossing plus1 adds a region; reverse orientation for k>n/2 is a reflection.

Use the parity identity S(n,m) congruent binomial(n-ceil(m/2),n-m) modulo2. Lucas carry-free criterion simplifies to(n-m)&floor((m-1)/2)==0. Handle empty partition and n<m explicitly. Public small dynamic-programming parity check required; no hidden answers read.

Create states for vertex plus player-to-move. First compute Georgiy-forced wins: his states are existential, Gennady states universal. Outside this attractor Georgiy cannot win; he then prefers terminating in a loss to a draw, while Gennady prefers a draw to a win. The same existential/universal attractor to Georgiy-terminal states yields forced finite Gennady wins in this subgame; all remaining states are draws. Terminal seeds and edges respect player alternation.
